title: Moving Up from Tailwise Plus Annual to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual — Program Rule and Customer Upgrade Tool
content:
## Program rule

Under **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, when a Tailwise Plus Annual member moves up to Tailwise Plus Premier Annual, the upgrade charge is collected with the card on file on the change date and a new Premier term starts that day with the annual perk credit of Tailwise Plus Premier Annual.

The upgrade charge is fixed only after every billing period the membership has started carries a charged membership fee. The upgrade charge is not fixed until every purchase refunded in the last 12 months carries its points reversal on the rewards ledger. The upgrade charge is fixed only after the rewards ledger carries a reissue of every certificate used on an order returned in the last 12 months.

## Upgrade tool: `upgrade_plus_tier_d51b9d82`

**Capability.** Moves the customer's own Tailwise Plus membership up to a higher paid tier today and pays the upgrade charge with the card on file. One call moves the membership to the chosen paid tier, starts a new paid term of one billing cycle today with automatic renewal on and the next fee due the day after the term ends, books one fee charge in the amount stated, books the perk credit the new term comes with (setting the perk credit balance to it), and, when an enrollment bonus is stated, books one enrollment bonus entry dated today and adds it to the points balance.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The care agent unlocks it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the customer's Pals Rewards membership, as given by the care agent from the membership record | identifier |
| `new_tier` | the paid tier moved up to: Tailwise Plus Annual (a move up from the monthly paid tier) or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual (a move up to the premier annual paid tier); Pals Rewards Member, Pals Rewards Insider and Pals Rewards VIP are free tiers and Tailwise Plus Monthly is the entry paid tier, none of them a target here | one of the six tier names |
| `upgrade_charge_usd` | the amount charged today for the upgrade, exactly as the care agent quoted it | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `perk_credit_usd` | the perk credit the new term comes with, as the care agent stated it; 0.00 when the new tier carries none | USD with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `enrollment_bonus_points` | the enrollment bonus posted with this move, as the care agent stated it; 0 when none is due | whole non-negative integer of points |

**Return.** On success: status `upgraded`, the `membership_id`, `variant_name` (the paid tier now held), `plus_term_start`, `plus_term_end`, `next_billing_date`, `member_event_id` (the fee charge's reference number), `amount_usd`, `perk_credit_balance_usd`, `enrollment_bonus_points` posted and `points_balance` afterwards.
